top_signals.title: Senators Say They Want More on F-35 Parts Diverted to China
top_signals.summary: Two key senators who oversee military and intelligence matters said they want the Pentagon to answer questions about how sensitive F-35 warplane parts ended up in China’s possession.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bond Selloff Deepens After 30-Year Yield Hits Highest Since 2004
top_signals.summary: Yields on the US’s longest-dated bonds climbed to the highest level in more than two decades, the latest milestone in a global selloff driven by inflation fears and concern about government debt burdens.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Akamai Surges on $12 Billion Anthropic AI Computing Deal | Closing Bell
top_signals.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Sally Bakewell, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: With Denmark, Saildrone logs first flag registration for naval surveillance drone
top_signals.summary: U.S. naval drone maker Saildrone seeks to expand its footprint in Europe, with Denmark a key customer in the contested Baltic and North seas.

top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Erin Hudson joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." A report from S&P Global Ratings found the health of US public schools is deteriorating. (Source: Bloomberg)
